headlines.title: Trump threatens to bomb Oman if it ‘gets in the way’ of Strait of Hormuz talks with Iran
headlines.description: President Donald Trump on Monday threatened to strike Oman if it interferes in a potential deal over control of the Strait of Hormuz.

headlines.title: Tupac murder trial legal teams lay out framework of their case in opening statements
headlines.description: The prosecution and defense delivered their opening statements in Tupac Shakur's murder trial. NBC News' Misty Marris discusses how the prosecution laid the framework for their case while defense attacked the credibility the case's credibility.

headlines.title: Hayden Panettiere, 'Heroes' and 'Nashville' Actor, Dies at 36
headlines.description: Police are investigating the sudden death of Hayden Panettiere, star of TV and film, after being found unresponsive at her South Carolina home. NBC’s Steve Patterson reports for TODAY.

headlines.title: Canada and U.S. resume trade talks ahead of Trump administration's new tariffs
headlines.description: The Canadian government continues to hold trade negotiations with the U.S. as the Trump administration plans to begin a fresh wave of tariffs. NBC News' Brian Cheung reports on what exports are targeted in the tariffs and what economic impact it could have.

headlines.title: Witness video of Madison police killing raises questions of why lethal force was used
headlines.description: Local authorities said that the matter is being investigated and that the officers involved have been placed on administrative leave.

headlines.title: Virginia State University shooting suspect sent Instagram chat saying ‘I’m tryna find the gun’
headlines.description: A shooting Saturday at Virginia State University that left five people injured allegedly stemmed from an argument involving the suspected shooter, court documents state.

headlines.title: Penn State students accused of running drug ring out of off-campus fraternities
headlines.description: More than a dozen Penn State University students are accused of packaging and selling cocaine as part of a multistate drug operation.

headlines.title: Oil jumps past $91 as Trump casts doubt on a new deal with Iran
headlines.description: The price of oil jumped sharply Monday after President Donald Trump cast doubt on another deal with Iran to extend the expiring ceasefire with Iran.

headlines.description: Canada ais racing to ink a deal with the Trump administration to avoid a fresh wave of U.S. tariffs on its exports, starting on Wednesday.

headlines.title: Supreme Court turns away Trump’s latest bid to block E. Jean Carroll award
headlines.description: The Supreme Court turned away for a second time President Donald Trump’s bid to overturn a jury verdict that awarded $5 million to writer E. Jean Carroll and found Trump liable for sexual abuse and defamation.
